svg.title: Preserved storage has no path to the live cache
svg.desc: Maintain a wide empty gutter between preserved storage and live cache. Its lack of a drawn transfer is a bounded depiction, not proof against every other continuity channel.

Its lack of a drawn transfer is a bounded depiction, not proof against every other continuity channel.", "lettering": [ { "box": [ 0.045, 0.78, 0.91, 0.18 ] } ], "lettering_mode": "manual", "nodes": [ { "asset": "sealed", "box": [ 0.06775, 0.2012, 0.3913, 0.276474 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "PRESERVED STORAGE", "label_box": [ 0.06775, 0.49443, 0.3913, 0.121481 ], "label_size": 18 }, { "asset": "folder", "box": [ 0.52275, 0.2012, 0.3913, 0.276474 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "REBUILT CACHE", "label_box": [ 0.52275, 0.49443, 0.3913, 0.121481 ], "label_size": 18 }, { "asset": "boundary", "box": [ 0.49363, 0.0734, 0.01274, 0.6248 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true } ], "reconstructed": false, "shot": "split", "source": "
**Frame:** Split image. Left: sealed preserved storage from Chapter 1. Right: the rebuilt live cache. No arrow crosses between them.

**Action:** Evidence preservation is distinguished from runtime memory.

**Caption:**
> NO MESSAGE CROSSES THE WIPE.

**Provenance:** `documented` — preserved storage and erased live cache remain distinct. The claim is exact and it is also incomplete: it concerns stored artifacts only. Model weights are not cache state and are not in this frame.
